## Interactive applications

### Regional Longevity Gains in Europe

Visualize subnational longevity trends across 450 European regions between 1992 and 2019.\
Companion to [Nature Communications (2026)](./publications/2026-alliger-natcomm.qmd).
→ [Launch app](https://histdemo.shinyapps.io/ReLoG_Europe/)

### Mortality by cause in Paris and Parisian neighborhoods, 1890–1949.

Visualize Parisian trends in cause-specific mortality and spatial differences across the 80 Parisian neighborhoods between 1890 and 1949.\
Companion to [Population and Development Review (2025)](./publications/2025-torres-padr.qmd).
→ [Launch app](https://mortalidad-pp.shinyapps.io/suppl_results_mortality_cod_paris/) · 

### COVID-19 mortality in Europe

Visualize the pandemic burden across more than 500 European regions in 2020 and 2021.\
Companion to [Nature Communications (2024)](./publications/2024-bonnet-natcomm.qmd).
→ [Launch app](https://histdemo.shinyapps.io/covid_mortality_in_2020_and_2021/)
